name: Up!
source:
Main character is a glasses wearing sophomore in high school. One day he starts to feel increased attention towards him from his stepmother and classmates.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是戴眼镜的高中二年级学生。某天起，他发现继母和同学们似乎格外关注自己。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
